versions.changelog: v4.4.0: docx write-back + term unification. -o on pipeline/transform/compare now writes Word files when the path ends in .docx (minimal OOXML plain paragraphs, closing the loop with .docx direct-read; tables/images/styles are not rebuilt - merge complex layouts manually; illegal control characters are stripped, and writing back onto the input file itself is rejected). check_terms gains --unify to emit a term-unified draft: each group unified to its dominant variant, per-variant replacement counts fully surfaced, mapping conflicts rejected loudly, longest-variant single-pass replacement against nesting - advisory output, review before adopting. Chinese doc trigger words now carry English equivalents. 770+ offline tests green across 23 suites, independent audit P0/P1 fixed. Zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v4.3.1: slim-down completion hotfix. Fixes a v4.3.0 omission where the Chinese document still carried the full feature-status table alongside the pointer to the standalone list - the main document now keeps only the experimental warning row and the stable-highlights summary, with references/feature_status.md as the single source of truth; the English document regains its table header. Zero functional change. 740+ offline tests green across 22 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v4.3.0: feature-status list sunk into a standalone document. The main document now keeps only the experimental warning row and a stable-highlights summary; the full bilingual per-generation capability list lives in references/feature_status.md (routed from INDEX). Progressive-reading density tightened further; zero functional change. 740+ offline tests green across 22 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v4.2.0: batch degradation completion + language-aware handoff. pipeline --batch now wires in chunk degradation - oversized files inside a batch no longer fail whole; degraded chunks are retried at double budget, the row carries a marker, and the CI gate stops on degraded rows. The deep-rewrite handoff sheet is now language-aware - English drafts anchor the English style guide directly, Chinese drafts the Chinese one, so agents stop cross-referencing the wrong manual. 720+ offline tests green across 22 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v4.1.0: displayName updated to 论文降AI率·去AI味改写 (paper AI-detection-rate reduction & de-AI-flavor rewriting) - the five-character phrase 论文降AI率 now covers four search phrasings (论文降AI / 降AI率 / 降AI / AI率) in one string; zero functional change. Also: reading map moved to the top of the document (30-second routing), a one-line disambiguation of the two layers (mechanical cleanup vs quality revision), and the deep-rewrite handoff sheet now mentions its one-command pipeline entry. 700+ offline tests green across 20 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v4.0.0: encoding auto-detection. Text inputs no longer need to be pre-converted to UTF-8 - UTF-16 (with BOM) and GBK/GB2312/GB18030 encodings are recognized and transparently transcoded (announced on stderr and exposed as meta.encoding in JSON; the file itself is never modified), so GBK files from Chinese Windows Notepad or legacy exports work directly. Thoroughly unrecognized encodings are still rejected with guidance, and the transcoder runs a sanity check so garbage bytes cannot masquerade as success. Batch progress files gain a concurrency lock (flock merge-on-write) - two batch runs on one directory no longer overwrite each other. 700+ offline tests green across 20 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.9.0: chunk-scan degradation + guard prescriptions. Chunked scanning of very large documents now degrades gracefully - a single chunk that times out is retried once at double budget, then marked degraded while the rest completes, with explicit coverage notes in the report (degraded_chunks in JSON); CI gates treat degraded scans as incomplete and stop (exit 2), and all-chunks-timeout fails loudly. verify integrity-guard failures now come with prescriptions: every violation gets a how-to-fix line, lost numbers get original-sentence anchors, and the report ends with a three-step repair guide (JSON remedies field) - no more guessing what to fix. Pitfalls list grown to 27. 680+ offline tests green across 19 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.8.0: PDF safe gate + deep-rewrite handoff sheet. The PDF extraction-confidence gate now defaults to medium - garbled-typical extractions are rejected by default with actionable guidance instead of mixing into reports and guard verdicts (--pdf-min-confidence low restores annotate-only). Batch mode gains a circuit-breaker: 3+ rejected PDFs in one run raise a batch-level warning pointing at source quality. pipeline gains --handoff: one command emits cleanup + guard results plus a per-sentence deep-rewrite instruction sheet (which sentence, what operation, what to guard, how to verify) - no separate plan run needed. Also: trigger conditions consolidated into the main document; translationese defined with examples and guide anchors. 620+ offline tests green across 18 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.7.0: batch resume + cross-file term drift + plain-language errors. --batch mode now checkpoints per-file progress to .pr_batch_state.json in the target directory; rerun with --resume to skip completed files (changed or previously failed files rerun automatically); detect and pipeline keep separate progress namespaces. check_terms gains --batch: detects cross-file variant drift (each file internally consistent, the set inconsistent - e.g. the abstract says patients while the discussion says subjects) and suggests a canonical term by global frequency. Error messages rewritten in plain language: binary/encoding/PDF-confidence gate messages now state the cause, the common origins and the next step. Also: FAQ expanded (term unification, resume, PDF confidence), feature-status table condensed, exit-code reference updated. 570+ offline tests green across 17 suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.6.0: medical knowledge-base markdown-aware edition. For .md inputs the scanner now strips markdown structure (headings, table rows, code blocks, lists, bold) before scoring - knowledge-base documents are rated on their prose, not their formatting; structure counts (headings/table rows/code blocks) are reported separately and never affect the score; --raw-markdown keeps the raw behavior. Wired into detect/pipeline/stylecheck. Also: verb-prefix recognition in term-group matching, new capability samples in examples, a process-class entry in pitfalls. 540+ offline tests green across sixteen suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.5.0: checklist and doc-architecture edition. A merged capability-x-boundary table puts what each capability does, what it does NOT do, and where to run it on one row. Every reference doc opens with when-to-read / shortest-path / back-to-INDEX lines plus a 30-second INDEX routing table. The submission self-check bundle gains a 07 finding ledger marking each issue resolved / partially answered / unresolved with a budget line. check_stats group-n matching now strips verb prefixes (enrolled/randomized/completed). Skip-when negative triggers added to both descriptions. 520+ offline tests green across fifteen suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.4.0: submission self-check bundle edition. New pipeline --bundle DIR generates a dated self-check package in one command - six files: style self-check report, revision audit log, before/after profile comparison, statistical consistency, terminology consistency, and the integrity verdict, plus a README - ready to hand to a supervisor or editor. The skill description is rewritten to match what you actually search for; --rewrite x --deep combination fixed; bundle failures now degrade gracefully without affecting the main report. 500+ offline tests green across fourteen suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.3.0: batch consistency edition. check_stats.py gains --batch directory mode with cross-file group-n aggregation - catches the abstract-says-120-methods-say-118 class of number conflicts that single-file checks cannot see; time-point variants (randomized n vs completed n) are recognized and reported as advisory candidates rather than hard failures. pipeline.py gains a --check-stats stage so one command runs the full workflow including statistical consistency (advisory, never changes the verdict). detect/pipeline accept --pdf-min-confidence 高/中/低 as a hard gate for risk-averse runs (default stays annotate-only). SKILL feature-status table compressed. 468 offline tests green across thirteen suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.2.0: statistical consistency guard. New check_stats.py catches three classes of numbers that fight each other: percent lists not summing to 100 (only sentences with partition cues like respectively - legitimate non-exhaustive lists such as comorbidity shares are never flagged), the same group appearing with two different n (time-point variants like final n are kept distinct - attrition is legitimate), and mixed p/P notation style (advisory only - journal conventions differ). Exit codes match check_terms so it drops straight into CI; JSON and markdown report outputs carry the original-data-first disclaimer. Also: expanded English trigger phrases and four FAQ answers deepened with concrete reading guides. 427 offline tests green across twelve suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.1.0: say-it-right release. Term guards upgrade to variant groups - one group can hold more than two forms (HF / 心力衰竭 / 心衰 reported as a single row), 8 domains / 27 groups / 55 variants with --pack selection. The style profile gains a stats panel (type-token ratio, function-word ratio, sentence-length quantiles; informational - read trends, no bands, no score change), exposed via stylecheck --json. detect/compare/pipeline accept a shorter --ci gate alias (same as --exit-verdict). SKILL.md adds a plain-language phrase table ('how to ask for this'), a before-to-after capability table, and a one-line routing rule - you know when to use this tool, how to phrase the ask, and exactly what it will change without reading everything first. 360 offline tests green across eleven suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v3.0.0: demand-word repositioning + operational deep-rewrite. displayName updated to match what you actually search for. PDF direct-read recalibrated: embedded-font (ToUnicode) PDFs are no longer blanket-rejected - extraction is attempted with confidence capped at Medium plus a spot-check note, while CJK CID files are still caught by the garbage probes with export guidance; a 200-file real-world calibration table ships in references/pdf_confidence.md. plan.py --handoff emits a per-sentence operation sheet (original sentence + directive + guard rules + acceptance commands) and a new references/deep_rewrite_guide.md defines the five-step rewrite loop. Term guards expand to 8 medical domains / 28 pairs with --pack selection and nesting-safety validation. 322 offline tests green across ten suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v2.9.0: substantive release. NEW fullwidth alnum normalization (transform/pipeline automatic): Chinese input methods silently turn 2025 into fullwidth 2025 - the v2.8.0 E_NUM_WIDTH red line catches it, and now transform fixes it in one step with a --track audit trail (fullwidth punctuation untouched; only letters and digits). Batch mode now accepts .pdf files mixed with text formats, annotating each with the v2.8.0 extraction confidence. SKILL guide gained a bilingual reading map routing each need to the right document. 137+20+25+21+11+16+13+23+9 offline tests green across nine suites, zero dependencies. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v2.8.0: substantive release, targeting the official evaluation's accuracy note head-on. NEW PDF extraction confidence self-report (read_text_ex): four heuristics - common-word hit rate (71-word academic probe set), control-character rate, average word length, extractable word count - combined into a three-band rating that detect and pipeline annotate on every PDF scan, turning 'review the output' into 'the tool tells you how trustworthy this extraction is', with cause-specific advice (split words / likely non-English text / too few words). Trigger-word variants expanded (academic rewriting / passage rewrite / expression polish). Guard repair: the language iron-law test was silently neutered by markdown table separators splitting the scanned text - rewritten to strip only the frontmatter and scan the full body. Low-band notes now explain their trigger cause instead of misdiagnosing tables as scans. 137+20+25+21+11+16+13+11 offline tests green across eight suites, zero dependencies. Plus five fixes from a 245-file real-corpus test by a sibling agent: a chunked-scan sentence-count crash, a fullwidth-form tampering blind spot (fullwidth 2025 passed silently as 2025 - now the E_NUM_WIDTH red line), a user-guard pathway for chatbot-category false positives, a W_SENT_ADDED warning for inserted sentences, and measured honesty-boundary data (98% of fluent ChatGPT texts score below 28 - a low score never means 'no AI involved'). NEW statistical-channel experiment settled (373 files measured): sentence-length band concentration is the strongest single statistical signal (AI corpora 0.68/0.72 vs human 0.48/0.47), integrated conservatively as an informational 'uniform rhythm flag' - 41% of 2023-era AI corpus flagged at a 3% human flag rate; it never alters scores. Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page if you find it useful.

v2.7.0: substantive release. NEW best-practices handbook (references/best_practices.md): seven real scenarios - journal submission, thesis chapters, reviewer responses, batch triage, CI gates, false-positive handling, CN punctuation - each with the standard command sequence and scenario-specific pitfalls. NEW stylecheck --html: the style profile and its --compare delta as a self-contained visual report. NEW pipeline --terms auto: generates a term-list draft on the fly (extract_terms logic) so the integrity guard works out of the box, with an explicit unreviewed-draft warning and a terms_note field in JSON. Bug fix found outside review: extract_terms' word-boundary regexes failed on CJK-adjacent abbreviations (IRAK4 in IRAK4抑制剂 was unextractable - same family as the verify.py v2.1.0 fix), now unified on CJK-safe lookarounds. Description gained an idempotent Trigger on routing block for agent installers. 137+20+25+21+11+16+13 offline tests green across seven suites, zero dependencies. 觉得有用的话，欢迎 Star（GitHub）或收藏（SkillHub 技能页）。

v2.6.0: substantive release. NEW style profile (stylecheck.py): the quantified acceptance lens for the style guide - per-paragraph jargon hits located with samples, sentence-rhythm CV, opener diversity, each banded (natural/observe/machine-flavored) with guide anchors, thresholds calibrated on four local corpora (AI corpora 17-37 jargon hits per 1000 chars vs zero for human-written). NEW --compare mode: a before/after delta table turns deep-revision acceptance from gut feeling into metrics. NEW pattern audit backstop (audit_patterns): all 158 regexes checked for unbounded greedy quantifiers - the catastrophic-backtracking safety net, wired into the release-chain version check. Review-hardened: the sent_cv direction inversion caught in review (human English corpus was mis-banded) is fixed with four-metric directional regression assertions. Plus agent-protocol routing for the new tool and bilingual flag cheat sheets. 137+20+25+21+11+16 offline tests green across six suites, zero dependencies.

v2.5.0: substantive release. NEW centralized error layer: all nine CLIs enter through one handler - user-facing failures print two Chinese lines (what went wrong + what to do) and exit 2 cleanly, while semantic exit codes pass through untouched. NEW batch second-pass retry: files that fail the first scan are automatically re-scanned with a doubled time budget (transient faults recover), with a per-file retried field in JSON and honest 'retried once' markers. NEW --step-timeout (default 120s) bounding every cleanup and scan stage, plus a timings block (cleanup/scan/verify) in the JSON report and a human-readable timing line. Engineering hardening: batch gates are now fail-closed (unscannable files never pass the verdict gate), all error messages localized. 137+20+25+21+11 offline tests green across five suites, zero dependencies.

v2.4.0: substantive release. NEW deterministic deep polish (--deep on transform/pipeline): sentence-level automatic transforms - canned opener deletion at sentence starts only, exclusion-connector merging (not-only-X-but-also-Y becomes plain X and Y) - zero-information-loss by design, every operation logged to --track, guarded by verify's whole-document integrity check. NEW handling-hints engine: 1-4 concrete next-step suggestions (plan.py queue, guard fixing, --profile general for non-academic text) in the report tail and JSON hints field. NEW scan wall-clock budget (120s default): pathological inputs now fail cleanly with exit 2 and a split-file suggestion instead of hanging. Plus engineering hardening: timeout errors exit 2 on all main paths, dead flags removed. 137+20+25+21 offline tests green across four suites, zero dependencies.

v2.3.0: substantive release. NEW plan.py - sentence-level rewrite priority queue: ranks sentences by weighted pattern contribution, with section attribution, handling advice and a linear budget projection (--json for agents). NEW learn_guards.py - turn a false positive into a reusable term guard (user_guards.json, survives upgrades; context-scoped, not whole-word whitelisting). Markdown headings (## Abstract / **Methods**) now recognized by section-aware scanning. Large-text chunking gained a 2,000-char overlap window - boundary-spanning signals are no longer missed (fixes the known v2.1.x chunk-boundary limitation) with rhythm stats restored to whole-text accuracy. Section-offset drift (v1.7.0-) fixed. PDF extraction hardened: no-space operators, UTF-16BE strings, 50MB cumulative decompression cap. Plus four precision fixes (compare .md exemption, numbered/bold heading regex, reference-line exemption, 50MB guard). 137+20 offline tests green, zero dependencies.
